headline: Adopted federally required drug and alcohol testing policy for transportation employees; tabled merger committee representative and monitoring report.
summary: The meeting covered fund balance, heating and cooling work, CESA, and a possible merger study. The group adopted a federally required policy on drug and alcohol testing for transportation employees. Two items were tabled, and the August superintendent's report was accepted.
decisions: Adopted policy B4, Drug and Alcohol Testing of Transportation Employees, unanimously.
Approved the consent agenda, including June 10, 2026 meeting minutes, bill approvals, and the City-WSD MOU, unanimously.
Accepted the August superintendent's report unanimously.
Tabled the assignment of a representative to the merger committee until the retreat.
Tabled the Internal Monitoring Report for this meeting.
Consensus that the City-WSD joint meeting will be held October 19th.

Table action on 6Biii until retreat- assignment of rep to merger committee, agenda waiting for feedback on other districts.
Discussion/action: Internal Monitoring Report ... Tabled for this Meeting.
Discussion: City-WSD Joint Meeting Date (10/19 or 11/02) ... Consensus: October 19th works best.
